notes.title: 🚀 Open Beta Update: New Launch Time! 🚀
notes.notes:
Great news, everyone! After some thorough troubleshooting and testing, we’ve fixed the critical error and have our Steam build up and running.

We’ll need a little more time to finalize some additional fixes, so the Open Beta will now officially launch at 2 PM (MST) tomorrow.

We’re sorry for this 1-day delay and truly appreciate your patience and support. We’re excited to see you all in the Arena tomorrow—thank you for being part of this journey! 🚀
